newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish automotive output down 13 pct in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Turkish automotive output down 13 pct in Oct.

text.p: Turkish automotive production fell 13 percent to 29,992 units last month compared to October 1995, while car production plunged 32 percent to 17,350 units, the Turkish Automotive Associaton (OSD) said.

The first ten months of this year saw an overall six percent increase in output to 267,376 units compared to last year, but car production fell by seven percent in the same period to 172,964 units, the OSD said in its monthly bulletin.

Ten-month output of buses surged by 120 percent when compared to the same 1995 period, midibuses by 61 percent, lorries by 58 percent, tractors by 43 percent, minibuses by 34 percent, and vans by 21 percent.

Car sales in January-October 1996 firmed by 8.12 percent to 178,618 unit from the same period in 1995. The OSD said this increase was entirely due to the sharp rise in imported car sales which tripled during this period to 38,789 units.
At the same time, sales of locally produced cars fell 8.5 percent to 139,829 units.
